screenshotStateObservations.observation: Displayed paytable at selected 0.05 DMO gives 0.75, 0.50, 0.25, 0.20, 0.10 for the respective symbol groups; at 0.10 DMO these values double.
Five fixed matching-symbol paylines, left-to-right adjacent reels, summed across lines; selected multiplier applies to current payline wins.
In-game panel displays version v1.0.1, RTP 96.39%, maximum win 145x and DMO stake limits 0.05 to 400.00. These do not establish a new engine RTP or ETB operator limits.
Visible bet menu begins 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40 DMO. Later AUTO view shows bottom BET 0.10 DMO. Full ladder and action timings are unknown.
AUTO dialog offers counts 25, 50, 100, 500, 1000 and conditions for single-win threshold and balance decrease/increase; actual start/cancel behavior was not established by this screenshot.
Music/effects visible states differ between the two settings screenshots. Audible sound and fullscreen action are unverified.
Help describes up to five red/black X2 attempts and taking a win. Gamble limit value, probabilities and actual gamble interaction remain unverified.

limitations: The current reviewer inspected retained screenshots and did not replay provider inputs or reconstruct an absent action log.
The seven supplemental result images do not add seven independently verified rounds to the canonical initial seven-round capture.
Supplemental screenshots have no continuous video or audio. They do not establish exact animation timing, touch latency or sound parity.
Earlier unbound paytable screenshots show incomplete/stale examples. They are retained as observations but are not numeric evaluator inputs.
Observed base paytable arithmetic does not reveal reel strips, outcome probabilities, possible grids, maximum-win enforcement or X2 settlement policy.
Provider images remain reference evidence, not runtime artwork.
